statement.p: For each of the following vector fields, determine whether a vector potential exists. If so, find one.

p.em: For this problem, enter your vectors with angle-bracket notation: \lt a, b, c>, not in ijk-notation.

static.solution:
(a) Since \mbox{div }\vec F = 0, we know that \vec F has a vector potential. One such is the vector field \vec H = \left(-1xy+10yz\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+\left(2xy+xz^{2}\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}, but there are many others.
(b) Since \mbox{div }\vec F = 20, we know that \vec F does not have a vector potential.
